About

I'm a product designer working across research, interface, and physical form.

Right now I own end-to-end UI and UX at Catalyst Intro, an early-stage platform opening pre-IPO startups to everyday investors.

I'm also at Columbia, studying Human-Centered Design and Innovation, UI/UX, and Product Design and Management courses.

Outside of that, I make art and take far too many pictures of sunsets, ducks, and anything else cute enough to justify stopping for. I also run a food page, where I photograph the meal for aesthetics, take one bite, and announce that I'm full, hehe.

A sneak peek into my life.
